We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be that the environment has a sample at hand (some unknown). We need to get carbon NMR to see aromatic carbon signals. But we need count of aromatic carbons. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get spectra, then identify aromatic region (~110-160 ppm). Count peaks? But need integer count of aromatic carbons. Could also use retrieve_carbon_shifts to get typical ranges, but not specific.

Probably we need to get carbon NMR and count peaks in aromatic region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
